module modified by Simon using JDAPI_LAF on Monday 08 September 2008 15:5:6****************************************************************************
*
* Title: SAUUINTD
* Author: Anthony G. White
* Date Written: 02-16-94
* Oracle Vers. Orig.: 7.0
* Forms Vers. Orig.: 3.0
* Revision History:
*
* Modified By Modified Date Version Description of changes
* ---------------------------------------------------------------
* Anthony White 02-16-94 1.0 Initial Version
* Michael Hoang 03-02-94 2.0 Bug fixes
* Michael Hoang 03-17-94 3.0 Bug fixes
* Anthony White 04-22-94 4.0 Change table name from compo-
* nents to active_prododucts.
* Anthony White 07-29-94 5.0 Change to reject product
* Chieu Nguyen 08-22-94 6.0 Increase reject code to 5
* characters.
* Chieu Nguyen 08-29-94 7.0 PTS:ST0067
* Sudi Lahiri 08-29-94 8.0 Parse_blood_type doesn't exist
* Chieu Nguyen 09-21-94 9.0 Do not check for duplicated.
* Linh Tran 03-10-95 9.1 Added online help
* Sri Ballapur 07-17-95 10.0 Qurantine Products to not to be
 rejected.
 Copying of product type
 onto discard_products.
 Validation for existance of
 products in shipped_products &
 active_products to be done at
 product level (not at unit level
 as in previous version).
* Abstract:
* This form is used to associate an interdiction with a product.
*
* Menu Reference:
*
* Error Conditions:
*
* 0000 - TRANSACTION COMMITTED
* 0200 - Invalid function key
* 0230 - Unseccessfull comit... transaction not saved
* 0300 - Invalid blood type
* 0309 - Invalid product code
* 0314 - Unit ID not checked in
* 0315 - ABO Label must be the same as system label decision
* 0700 - Invalid scan length
* 3737 - Product in quarantine, cannot be rejected.
* 6001 - Invalid interdiction code
* 6002 - Duplicate interdiction code for this product
*
* Inputs:
* Unit ID, Product code, Aliquot, and Interdiction code.
*
* Outputs:
* Update the following data base tables:
* 1. Product_interdictions
*
* Modules Referenced:
* Check_Package_Failure, Handle_Error, Nullchk, Show_Error
*
* Assumptions and Limitations:
*
* Functional Descriptions:
* This form will allow the user to input a unit ID, product code and
* blood type and pulls up the interdictions that apply to the unit. The
* user can then enter more interdictions.
* The table product_interdictions is the table that gets updated.
*
*****************************************************************************

DECLARE
 temp_unit_id VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_v_item1 varchar2(60); --For returning Checkdigit 
BEGIN
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 execute_trigger('VALIDATE_FIELD');
 check_package_failure;
 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' THEN
 IF :GLOBAL.chk_digit != '-*' THEN
 show_error_dist('1230');
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;
 temp_v_item1 := substr(:GLOBAL.field_left,1,instr(:GLOBAL.field_left,'.')) ||
 get_item_property(:GLOBAL.field_left, nextitem);
 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' THEN
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id || 
 lpad(to_char(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year),2,'0') ||
 substr(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no,1,6);
 --:GLOBAL.chk_digit := substr(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no,8,1);
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := substr(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no,7,2); 
 
 copy(:GLOBAL.chk_digit, temp_v_item1); 
 ELSIF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'C' THEN
 copy('', temp_v_item1); 
 END IF;
 END IF;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
END;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_v_unit_id varchar2(17) := ltrim(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id) ||
 ltrim(lpad(to_char(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year),2,'0')) ||
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 temp_v_unit_serial_no varchar2(11) := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no ; 
 temp_v_out_unit_id varchar2(15) := null;
 temp_v_out_chk_digit varchar2(2) := null; 
BEGIN
 default_value(NULL,'GLOBAL.unit_serial_no') ; 
 IF (NVL(length(temp_v_unit_serial_no), 0) in ('7','10') or :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL) 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id IS NULL 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year IS NULL
 THEN
 -- Assume it to be a CODABAR unit.
 IF :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF temp_v_unit_serial_no = :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no THEN
 Validate_Unit_Scan_Codabar(temp_v_unit_id,'M','C',temp_v_out_unit_id);
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_v_out_unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL; 
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'C';
 :GLOBAL.coll_id := null;
 :GLOBAL.coll_year := null;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := null;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left); 
 ELSE
 IF NVL(length(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no), 0) != 
 NVL(length(:GLOBAL.unit_serial_no), 0) THEN
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := ''; 
 show_error_dist('0049');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'I';
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := ''; 
 show_error_dist('0045');
 check_package_failure;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id := NULL; 
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'C';
 message('Please re-enter unit ID.',NO_ACKNOWLEDGE); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSIF NVL(length(temp_v_unit_serial_no), 0) in ('7','9','10','11') 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id IS NOT NULL 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 IF nvl(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_type,'X') = 'I' or NVL(length(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no), 0) > 7 THEN
 show_error_dist('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 go_item('user_response.user_response'); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE 
 --Check for Multiple Codabar / Code 128 Records
 /*IF :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NULL or
 (:GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL AND
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no != :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no) 
 THEN
 check_multiple_units(temp_v_unit_id,:global.chapter_id );
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;*/ 
 Validate_unit_scan_Code128(temp_v_unit_id,'M','I',temp_v_out_unit_id,temp_v_out_chk_digit); 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := null;
 IF temp_v_out_chk_digit = '-*' THEN
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := temp_v_out_chk_digit;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := substr(temp_v_unit_id,1,13);
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'I';
 -- go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 ELSE
 show_error_dist('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF; 
END;

procedure ins_discard_products is
 t_count Number;
begin
 begin
 select count(*) into t_count from pick_slip_products
 where unit_id = :unit_id 
 and product_code = :product_code 
 and aliquot = :aliquot
 and product_status = 'OD';
 if t_count <= 0 
 then
 insert into discard_products
 (CHAPTER_ID, UNIT_ID, COLL_DATE, ALIQUOT,
 PRODUCT_CODE, BLOOD_TYPE, PRODUCT_STATUS,
 EXP_DATE, DISCARD_TYPE, LOCATION_ID, PRODUCT_TYPE,
 INSERT_DATE, REJECT_REASON, program_id, warehouse_id)
 select :GLOBAL.chapter_id, :unit_id, :coll_date,
 :aliquot, :product_code, :GLOBAL.blood_type,
 'CK', :exp_date, 'RJ', :location_id,
 :product_type, :insert_dats, :reject_code,
 :banner.prog_name, :GLOBAL.warehouse
 from vserv_products
 where product_code = substr(:product_code,1,5) 
 AND unit_scheme_type = decode(NVL(length(:product_code), 0),5,'C','I')
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: DEL_ACTIVE_PRODUCTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure del_active_products is
begin
 begin
 delete active_products
 where unit_id = :unit_id
 and coll_date = :coll_date
 and product_code = :product_code
 and aliquot = :aliquot
 and blood_type = :GLOBAL.blood_type
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: COMMIT_TRANSACTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure commit_transaction is
begin
 begin
 :system.message_level := 5;
 ins_discard_products;
 del_active_products;
 commit;
 if form_success
 then
 show_error_dist('0000'); -- transaction committed
 check_package_failure;
 down;
 else
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error_dist('0230'); -- unsuccessful commit .. transaction
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 end;
end;
